select a.id as account_id
from account a
where a.industry_code in ('healthcare_clinics','auto_services','fitness')
  and jsonb_path_exists(a.attributes, '$.location_count ? (@ >= 2 && @ <= 40)')
  and a.country = 'ES'
  and a.attributes ? 'territory_id'
  and not exists (
        select 1 from suppression s
         where s.scope = 'account' and s.value = a.id::text)

audience.sql:
select p.id as person_id
from person p
where jsonb_path_exists(p.attributes, '$.lifetime_orders ? (@ >= 1)')
  and jsonb_path_exists(
        p.attributes, '$.predicted_churn_risk ? (@ >= 0.3 && @ <= 0.85)')
  and p.consent_state ->> 'email' = 'consent'
  and p.country in ('ES','PT','FR','IT')
  and not exists (
        select 1 from suppression s
         where s.scope = 'person' and s.value = p.id::text)

select a.id as account_id
from account a
where a.employee_band in ('51-200','201-500')
  and a.industry_code = 'software'
  and a.country in ('ES','FR','DE','NL','GB','US')
  and not exists (
        select 1 from suppression s
         where s.scope = 'account' and s.value = a.id::text)
  and not exists (
        select 1 from opportunity o
         where o.account_id = a.id and o.status = 'open')
